authority.note: Research requirements, not evidence of deployed controls or authorization to bypass gates

principles: Prefer machine decision where input, policy and observable evidence can determine an outcome
Use model only for irreducibly semantic or uncertain decisions; require typed output and independent verification
Human judgement only for value-tradeoff, irreversible, novel or low-confidence decisions
Do not create a second queue, router, memory ledger, scheduler, incident manager or policy engine
All consequential decisions include provenance, clock, version and an independent falsifier
A FAIL and a BLIND are distinct; neither is PASS
Experiment first on an isolated non-effectful path; promote only after valid canary and live receipt

evidence_classification.code_present: File or implemented function inspected on main; not a claim of live health or complete wiring
evidence_classification.historical_proposal: Earlier written requirement; actual implementation and liveness not established by this research
evidence_classification.integration_gap: Necessary behaviour not demonstrated across the actual entry and effect doors

baseline.agent_failure_type: hardcoded Gemini plus MiniMax fallback both capacity refused; firewall and submit-lane skipped

sample_2026_11_11.note: Historical batch outcomes, not unique-change failure rate or CI billing

baseline.health: Current production health, provider balances, plan coverage and CI-success rate NOT established by this register

key_relations: FounderIntent -> derives Instruction -> creates accepted Obligation
Obligation -> owns Task -> is leased to AgentSession under Claim
Candidate -> is evaluated against PolicyDecision at exact source/base/policy versions
Failure -> has FailureClass -> creates or updates one Incident and RecoveryLease
VerificationReceipt -> proves Effect -> can settle Obligation
Notification -> summarizes Incident/Outcome, never defines truth

requirements.owner: FLOW instruction intake + existing identity door
requirements.contract: For each accepted founder intent issue stable intent_id, immutable source quote/digest, authorised issuer, expected outcome, constraints, scope, accepted_at and policy revision. De-duplicate event replay using idempotency key.
requirements.positive: One accepted event creates one durable obligation with causal identity.
requirements.negative: Replay, contradictory override, unsigned issuer and missing outcome cannot mint duplicate/accepted obligation.

requirements.contract: Before selecting an executor resolve existing capability id, version, authority, cost, effect class, endpoint, owner, proof window and known alternate execution doors from the ONE registry.
requirements.positive: Known bot-commit/Greenlane/intent route is discovered without asking a model to improvise a new tool.
requirements.negative: Undeclared, stale or duplicate capability must not be treated as live or replace an existing control.

requirements.contract: Before costly generation bind candidate task+actor+intended changed paths+effect class+current main SHA+incident epoch+claim lease+policy revision; return ALLOW, REFUSE or BLIND with exact reason and executable bounded next route.
requirements.positive: Allow independent test-only task with valid scope, capacity and claim.
requirements.negative: The precise #8105 protected AGENTS.md and docs/standards paths while critical incident is open are refused BEFORE provider invocation or PR.

requirements.contract: Read current authenticated incident inventory; evaluate entire planned aggregate scope against exact policy base; UNKNOWN inventory is BLIND, not an inferred grant. Re-evaluate after changes in incident state or source base.
requirements.positive: A closed independently resolved incident re-arms admissible nonprotected tasks.
requirements.negative: Synthetic dof-probe and protected changed path with forged Genesis-Resolves do not authorize effect.

requirements.contract: Claim exact path set once with atomic ownership lease and overlap check; no claim without workspace allocation; heartbeat and compare-and-swap on renew/transfer.
requirements.positive: Twenty disjoint tasks claim concurrently without overlap.
requirements.negative: Two agents racing same path cannot both own it; expired claim cannot silently keep ownership.

requirements.contract: Before model allocation resolve provider deployment capability and healthy state, quotas, request windows, Retry-After, estimated tokens/cost, concurrent reservations and task criticality; grant a short TTL capacity lease or durable DEFERRED decision. A router-unavailable state is explicit and does not license blind hardcoded fallback.
requirements.positive: Healthy capable deployment reserved under limit and released on completion.
requirements.negative: Simulate both Gemini and MiniMax 429: zero duplicate provider calls until eligible capacity changes, obligation retained for resume.

requirements.contract: Map vendor 401/403 to auth fault, 402 to credit, 429 to quota exhaustion/reset, timeout to degraded; persist deployment-specific state and circuit breaker; recover on independently observed reset/probe, never timer-only assumption.
requirements.positive: Single 429 with trusted reset header parks one deployment and redirects only to independently available capable deployment.
requirements.negative: Multiple simultaneous sessions cannot overwhelm an exhausted deployment by independently retrying it.

requirements.contract: Remove direct provider-specific choice from privileged agent task admission; select through existing router by capability/price/health/authorization; preserve fully isolated worktrees and transcripts on provider switch. Operator still may specify explicitly authorised provider when policy permits.
requirements.positive: Provider changes preserve original obligation and exact evidence chain.
requirements.negative: No surviving filesystem modifications, private transcript, secret or conversation state from a failed provider reach fallback.

requirements.contract: Every accepted obligation has durable state, lease expiry, heartbeat, checkpoint, retry cause and last verified effect; session death cannot mark it complete or lose custody. Atomic CAS transition and append-only effects; no duplicate work on crash/restart.
requirements.positive: Crash after capacity reservation but before output resumes once or releases capacity.
requirements.negative: Simultaneous zombie sweeper and late worker cannot both commit completion or erase unique uncommitted work.

requirements.contract: Reconstruct exact staged diff against trusted base outside untrusted runtime; reject policy/validator/hook/workflow edits without independent protected-change authority. Run relevant deterministic lint, parse, type, test and path checks before remote branch/PR, from protected policy sources, with explicit SKIPPED/BLIND.
requirements.positive: Valid independently allowlisted patch reaches canonical lane with exact SHA and all applicable fast proof.
requirements.negative: Missing formatter, altered validator, nonexistent test runner, syntax error, staged path outside plan or changed main fails before PR.

requirements.contract: Use exact authenticated authorization proof tied to actor, patch digest, path scope, expiry and policy version for protected changes. GitHub bot committer identity and X-Idp-Signed presence do not themselves grant protected workflow founder authority.
requirements.positive: Genuine founder-authorized protected patch passes independent gate.
requirements.negative: Invented trailer, API commit, unauthorised workflow path or expired approval cannot effect trusted workflow modification.

requirements.contract: Only trusted engine promotes tested candidate; required checks refer to exact SHA, main base and current policy epoch; preserve lane when red and use bisection; no hand-raised red PR as agent delivery.
requirements.positive: Single passing candidate reaches main with independent readback.
requirements.negative: Mutated head, stale base, missing required check or unsigned protected file never lands.

requirements.contract: Fingerprint canonical (failure class, candidate SHA, base SHA, policy/incident epoch); unchanged deterministic failure parks without re-consuming same CI. Reset only on genuinely new evidence, edited patch, base/policy or incident state. Record cost of retries per failure class.
requirements.positive: Twenty identical failure reporters aggregate to one held cause.
requirements.negative: Unchanged failing head cannot spend more identical checks or issue twenty new alerts.

requirements.contract: Probe liveness AND goal; tri-state verdict; update one canonical incident per failure-class/scope; bound alert and auto-remediation backoff; do not infer recovery from a process alive or HTTP 200.
requirements.positive: One actual recovery closes the incident with fresh independent receipt.
requirements.negative: A healthy process with unmet objective must remain FAIL; 20 repeated observations must not create 20 incidents.

requirements.contract: One severity-ranked notification per active owner/failure-class/time-window; routine CI repeats update structured evidence, not user inbox. Never silence materially new security fault; deliver one founder digest based on verified state and links.
requirements.positive: Same failure across 20 agents yields one founder-visible incident card and one bounded digest, no comment storm.
requirements.negative: A novel critical breach still pages even during active suppression.

requirements.contract: Every gate emits PASS, FAIL or BLIND with instrument SHA, input SHA, elapsed, effect scope and falsifier proof; no silent skip. Candidate green is distinct from main green and production verified.
requirements.positive: Real deploy produces independent callback/effect/readback receipt.
requirements.negative: Gate disabled, absent tool, fabricated transcript or missing telemetry cannot settle obligation.

requirements.contract: Join intent/task/agent/provider/candidate/check/runtime effect into one causal measurement chain with event/source versions and unknown dimensions; compute cost per verified yield, retry time, CI minutes, alert counts, false refusals and throughput from independent sources.
requirements.positive: Every completed obligation traces to cost and independently observed production effect.
requirements.negative: Missing invoice/runner timings marked UNKNOWN rather than zero or free.

requirements.contract: Expose current source, owner, freshness and authoritative control status in one machine-readable view at session start and before dispatch; stale memory is tagged CONTEXT, never AUTHORITY. Ensure all runtimes/CLI/Genesis read same record.
requirements.positive: New model session sees current incident/lease/capacity before attempting work.
requirements.negative: Old cached AGENTS text or out-of-window cluster state cannot certify live health.

requirements.contract: Every loop declares sense, decide, act, prove, remember with trigger, bound, recurrence key, responsible owner and rollback. One existing schedule/event trigger per loop; wake on fresh evidence, not arbitrary polling if avoidable.
requirements.positive: Blocked mission is automatically reconsidered when quota resets or policy changes.
requirements.negative: No infinite recursive wakeups, duplicate schedules or model called just to read a clock/status.

requirements.contract: Reserve worktree before finalizing task claim; heartbeat on claim; preserve uncommitted work in quarantine on cleanup; audit all worktrees/branches/stashes as owned outcomes with TTL and proof.
requirements.positive: After worker death work is recoverable from archive or untouched worktree.
requirements.negative: No silent deletion, ghost running task, duplicate CAS completion or unowned orphan lane.

requirements.contract: Classify each action machine/model/judgment using actual executable rule and source. Explicit irreducibility for human, model confidence for probabilistic output, no self-declared authority. Build once and retire duplicated decision logic.
requirements.positive: Deterministic branch/rate-limit/claim decisions never require an LLM.
requirements.negative: Claim 'human needed' without value-tradeoff/irreversible/novel/low-confidence reason fails registry validation.

requirements.contract: For each admission policy assert positive and negative fixtures, concurrency falsifier, removal-of-gate mutation and real decision readback. Shadow/canary before broad enforcement; if legitimate work falsely denied, rollback only new scope while retaining security invariants.
requirements.positive: A/B canary lowers predictable red PR rate without dropping authorised throughput.
requirements.negative: Removing admission hook makes the negative test fail, and no-op 'green' cannot pass.

requirements.contract: Enumerate all code-producing and promoting doors (agent-sandbox, direct GitHub API, bot-commit, agent-trunk, Greenlane, maintenance, alternate repos). Classify the actor and enforce invariant at the genuine side-effect boundary, not by instructions alone.
requirements.positive: Same known-red patch is refused consistently regardless of harness or connector.
requirements.negative: A direct API-created PR or bot commit does not silently evade DoF, claim or protected-source scope.

requirements.contract: Reserve language models for planning, semantic code generation, diagnosis of novel cases and tradeoff alternatives; require typed bounded proposals, source evidence and deterministic admission/verification around every output. Compare model combinations with controlled negative results.
requirements.positive: Model supplies novel repair proposal and machine independently proves outcome.
requirements.negative: A model's self-rated confidence or narrative cannot certify release or vendor budget.

requirements.contract: Rollout sequence: read-only coverage baseline; 20-worker adverse replay; isolated canary through trusted promotion; independent actual main SHA; measured live admission decisions; expand by explicit effect scope; watch false denials and rollback. Do not convert an unverified branch into mandatory enforcement.
requirements.positive: Legitimate safe lane lands; known invalid candidate never creates PR; matched before/after metrics independently confirm improvement.
requirements.negative: Live visitor/caller evidence absent, source not merged, audit trail missing, or provider reroute hardcoded means status remains NOT_DELIVERED.

release_gates.name: Evidence
release_gates.test: Each source-backed requirement must point to current source artifact and have explicit historical/live confidence.

release_gates.name: Canary
release_gates.test: A correct safe candidate proceeds with real claim/capacity/signing/CI and no new broad outage.

release_gates.name: Falsification
release_gates.test: Known 8105 invalid patch, forged authority, 429, stale incident and interrupted worker are all rejected or deferred before costly effect.

release_gates.name: Concurrency
release_gates.test: 20 simultaneous workers and duplicate event replay: no duplicate execution/claim ownership, repeated CI or alert storm.

release_gates.name: Promotion
release_gates.test: Trusted App/Founder authorized exact SHA on main; Greenlane/CI checks and real caller evidence read independently.

release_gates.name: Learning
release_gates.test: Optimus/Genesis show distinct BEFORE/AFTER outcomes plus UNKNOWN accounting and correction ownership.

operational_sequence.name: Inventory and truth
operational_sequence.deliverable: Generate one machine-readable baseline showing every existing effect door, owner, active source version, read freshness and measurement gaps; no gates switched on.

operational_sequence.name: Safe admission
operational_sequence.deliverable: Read-only admission verdict -> isolated deny/allow canary -> authenticated promotion and identical verdict at all write doors.

operational_sequence.name: Capacity and custody
operational_sequence.deliverable: One router decision with reservation/failover/429 circuit breaker; durable recoverable tasks; no unchanged retries.

operational_sequence.name: Churn reduction and closure
operational_sequence.deliverable: One canonical cause, no red PRs from predictable faults, bounded alerts, independent effect proofs.

operational_sequence.name: Optimisation and research
operational_sequence.deliverable: Measured machine-decision share, evaluated model residual, 20-way regression and cost per verified yield.

open_questions_requiring_machine_evidenc: Does current deployed model router offer a remotely reachable admission/capacity API from Github Actions? Source implementation alone cannot establish network reachability.
What principal can issue protected-workflow founder passkey approvals tied to a patch digest? No approval may be inferred from GitHub admin rights.
What proportion of every source writer across all estate repositories is actually forced through trusted-effect admission?
Which current producer writes authoritative FLOW/QUAD obligation IDs and can they be joined to Greenlane, runner costs and effects without another database?
Does the production 20-agent notification pathway have a single sink and a deduplicated incident identity?
Which CI checks are required by live GitHub rulesets at this exact timestamp; the code docs may be stale?
change_policy: This register must NOT be treated as proof of production or used to trigger a new PR, model run, GitHub workflow, provider spending, policy bypass or gate activation.
